question: What do we know about the generational wealth transfer, and how are these five preparing for it?

cells.label: fact

items.text: Morgan Stanley's Wealth Management supports clients through three channels—Advisor-Led, Self-Directed, and Workplace—and includes financial advisor-led brokerage, investment advisory, custody, cash management, administrative services, self-directed brokerage, financial and wealth planning, workplace services including stock plan administration, securities-based lending, residential and commercial real estate loans, banking, and retirement plan services.
items.quote: Wealth Management supports clients through three channels: Advisor-Led, Self-Directed and Workplace. Wealth Management includes: financial advisor-led brokerage, investment advisory, custody, cash management, and administrative services; self-directed brokerage services; financial and wealth planning services; workplace services, including stock plan administration; securities-based lending, residential and commercial real estate loans and other lending products; banking; and retirement plan services.

items.text: Morgan Stanley describes its integrated firm's capabilities through clients' growth cycles, offering Founders Wealth Strategies at early stage, full-service wealth advice and asset allocation, family office solutions and trust & estate planning for preserving wealth, and private shares trading and lending and IPO execution to unlock liquidity.
items.quote: Founders / Employees ... Early Stage ... Invest for the Future ... Financial Wellness and Employee Benefits ... Founders Wealth Strategies ... Preserve Wealth ... Full-Service Wealth Advice and Asset Allocation ... Family Office Solutions, Trust & Estate Planning ... Unlock Liquidity ... Private Shares Trading & Lending ... IPO Execution and Support Services

items.text: Morgan Stanley states it invests to broaden financial advisor capabilities including alternatives and privates, tax-efficient investing, digitized assets, family office and OCIO, and tailored lending.
items.quote: We are using our scale to invest in broadening capabilities for FAs that are difficult for others to replicate: alternatives and privates, tax-efficient investing, digitized assets, family office and OCIO, and tailored lending.

items.text: Morgan Stanley expanded its collaboration with Carta in private markets and in digital assets through announced partnerships with Zero Hash to service clients with unique capabilities.
items.quote: In the third quarter, we continue to invest, deepening our competitive moats in areas like our expanded collaboration with Carta in private markets and in digital assets through announced partnerships with Zero Hash.

items.text: Morgan Stanley's Parametric platform offers custom investment solutions and separately managed accounts, and the firm highlights retail-oriented distribution offerings flowing through the Wealth Management relationship.
items.quote: Our industry-leading Parametric platform, Inclusive of Overlay, has grown to $575 billion... the relationship with Wealth Management, continues to benefit the Investment Management platform with the enhancement of retail-oriented distribution offerings and additional product capabilities.

items.text: Morgan Stanley offers evergreen products and products that allow for lower denomination size to make private alternatives more accessible to retail clients.
items.quote: We're offering new products to our clients, such as evergreen products and products that allow for lower denomination size.

items.text: Morgan Stanley's E*TRADE self-directed platform and workplace channel serve as the top-of-funnel client acquisition with financial education and referral model beginning at the financial education spot, feeding into advice-based relationships.
items.quote: we're working on that referral model. And that's something that can begin as early as the financial education spot, and it can also begin -- like I said, we have examples with 401(k)s and new 401(k) assets... I'm really giving people that ability to better understand where they could use advice.

items.text: Morgan Stanley acquired E*TRADE and expanded workplace offering; since 2020 it generated over $400 billion of new adviser-led assets from relationships that originated from Workplace or E*TRADE.
items.quote: Since 2020, we have generated over $400 billion of new adviser-led assets from relationships that originated from either Workplace or E*TRADE.

items.text: Morgan Stanley provides family office solutions and OCIO, and does work servicing founders and family offices as part of its wealth coverage.
items.quote: We've done a lot of work on trying to service founders, on trying to service family offices.

cells.reason: The passages describe specific products, services, and platforms (channels, alternatives, Parametric, Carta/Zero Hash partnerships, family office solutions, E*TRADE/workplace funnel) that Morgan Stanley offers to attract and serve next-generation clients.
